title: English Practice Quiz 0268
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: Decide is commonly followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: A place where medicines are dispensed is a ___.
questions.explanation: A pharmacy is a place where medicines are prepared or supplied.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.
